data.exact_reserve_text: Claims incurred, net of reinsurance, totalled GBP 448.0 million during the calendar year (2015: GBP 308.2 million). This includes an amount of GBP 33.1 million in respect of increases to reserves on 2014 and prior underwriting years (2015: GBP 33.6 million in respect of reserve releases from 2013 and prior underwriting years).

prior_year_events.event_name: Incoming reinsurance to close of the 2013 year of account
prior_year_events.impact_description: Included within the 2014 year of account result is a loss of GBP 15.7 million on business transacted in prior years inherited through the incoming reinsurance to close of the 2013 year of account.

prior_year_events.event_name: Revision of the Ogden discount rate
prior_year_events.impact_description: The revision of the Ogden rate from 2.5% to minus 0.75% resulted in a material impact to the results of the Syndicate, particularly on the 2014 year of account.

prior_year_events.event_name: Increase to reserves on 2014 and prior underwriting years (stated net)
prior_year_events.impact_description: The accounts state an increase to reserves of GBP 33.1 million in respect of increases to reserves on 2014 and prior underwriting years (net of reinsurance).

data.standardized_narrative: At 1 January 2016 gross claims outstanding were GBP 1,157.9m. Using the syndicate's gross claims development table (gross triangle) and excluding the aggregate '2010 & prior' column, the calculated gross prior-year development (excluding the two most recent underwriting years) indicates a net adverse movement (strengthening) of approximately GBP 61.3m (c.5.3% of opening gross reserves). The report attributes reserve deterioration to higher claims experience driven by increased global natural catastrophes and significant legal/discounting developments (notably the revision of the Ogden rate), and also notes the impact of an incoming reinsurance-to-close of the 2013 year which contributed an adverse impact included within 2014 results. The figure reported in the narrative for prior-year movements is GBP 33.1m but that is stated net of reinsurance; the gross movement has been estimated from the gross development triangle.
raw_causal_phrases: The revision of the Ogden rate from 2.5% to minus 0.75% has resulted in a material impact to the result of the Syndicate, particularly on the 2014 year of account.
There has been an increased prevalence of global natural disasters in the 2016 calendar year
The results have been significantly impacted by the change in the Ogden rate for bodily injury claims that was announced on 27 February 2017.

data.data_quality_notes: Prior-year gross movement was not provided explicitly as a single gross figure. The gross prior-year development has been estimated from the gross claims development table (triangle) on page 34. The report explicitly states a net prior-year increase of GBP 33.1m (net of reinsurance) which was used for cross-checking. The development triangle contains an aggregated '2010 & prior' column which was excluded per instructions. The syndicate also noted an incoming RITC (2013) and an Ogden rate change (announced Feb 2017) which distort/affect comparability; as a result the gross PYD estimate should be treated as an approximation. LOB-level reserve movements were not disclosed by gross amount, so LOB entries are directional and of moderate confidence.
